name: Rooibos Tea
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Caffeine-free so won't stimulate gut motility.
preparationTips: Steep 1-2 tea bags or 1 tsp loose tea in hot water for 5-7 minutes
Can be enjoyed hot or cold without affecting FODMAP content
Add lactose-free milk or small amounts of maple syrup if desired
Naturally caffeine-free so safe to drink evening
nutritionalHighlights: Contains minerals like calcium, iron, and zinc
